## Description {#details}

<p><a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/structs/llvm/object/chainedfixuptarget">ChainedFixupTarget</a> holds all the information about an external symbol necessary to bind this binary to that symbol.</p>


<p>These values are referenced indirectly by chained fixup binds. This structure captures values from all import and symbol formats.</p>


<p>Be aware there are two notions of weak here: WeakImport == true The associated bind may be set to 0 if this symbol is missing from its parent library. This is called a "weak import." LibOrdinal == BIND_SPECIAL_DYLIB_WEAK_LOOKUP This symbol may be coalesced with other libraries vending the same symbol. E.g., C++'s "operator new". This is called a "weak bind."</p>


<p>Definition at line 275 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/object/macho-h">MachO.h</a>.</p>
